metadata.case_name: LIU SHUI BIK v. COUNTFORTUNE LTD AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: part-time domestic helper or shop attendant

injuries.description: Mild prolapse at the L5/S1 level (lumbar disc prolapse) with 8% whole person impairment
source: An MRI scan on 23 March 2006, 10 months after the accident, demonstrated a mild prolapse at the L5/S1 level.
the present physical impairment of Mdm Liu, from orthopaedic consideration was 8% whole person impairment of the whole body.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: Depressive episode in reaction to the stresses related to her accident with mild impairment of activities of daily living and social functioning
source: A joint report by psychiatrists instructed by each side resulted in the joint opinion that Mdm Liu suffered from a depressive episode in reaction to the stresses related to her accident, the physical symptoms after the accident, and the associated psychosocial stresses and conflicts related to her circumstances.
It was the joint opinion of the psychiatrists that Mdm Liu suffers mild impairment of activities of daily living and social functioning consequent upon the psychiatric condition.

manifestations.description: Tenderness and muscle spasm over her right side and lower back region
Pain at her waist (low back pain)
Pain spreading to her right leg
Present physical impairment assessed as 8% whole person impairment
Need to alternately sit and stand (evidence of continuing pain and discomfort)
Laboured and slow walking; uses a quadrapod walking stick and an umbrella as support
Mild impairment of activities of daily living

treatments_received: applied liniment from a bone setter at home
examination at Pok Oi Hospital Outpatient Clinic
referred to the Orthopaedic Clinic at Alice Ho Miu Ling Nethersole Hospital at Tai Po
admitted as an inpatient and stayed for 17 days
psychiatric and psychological treatment in the public sector
treatments_future: a short course of more intense psychological treatment in the private sector consisting of five sessions of psychological therapy (cost $10,000)

losses.description: Present physical impairment assessed as 8% whole person impairment following lumbar disc prolapse.
Laboured and slow walking; requires use of a quadrapod walking stick and umbrella for support; need to alternate sitting and standing.
Mild impairment of activities of daily living consequent upon the psychiatric condition.
Mild impairment of social functioning consequent upon the psychiatric condition.
